card.name: Grade numbers in toxicity ranges
card.fires_on: The digit right after "Grade" or "Grades" (also "genotypes") that begins a range or list such as 3-4, 1 to 4, or 2 or 3, in adverse-event text.

modes.label: Grade range start
modes.description: A grade digit that opens a range or pair of severity grades.

modes.label: Genotype list start
modes.description: A genotype number that opens a list of genotypes.
